test_chat_completion: test the chat completion endpoint with system and user prompts and verify response format and token usage
test_chat_completion_stream: test the chat completion streaming endpoint and verify delta content, completion id consistency, and finish reasons
test_completion_with_response_format: test the chat completion endpoint with structured response formats including json_object, json_schema, and invalid schemas
test_chat_template: test applying chat templates like llama3 and command-r to messages and verify the generated prompt format
test_logprobs: test the chat completion endpoint with logprobs enabled and verify per-token log probabilities and top logprobs
